review: Second intensive static review of three uncorroborated registry-labelled samples
method: Verified all supplied SHA-256 values; listed TAR members and inspected every member byte.
Ran atomscan in slow/local/no-update mode and cleave facts on all originals and both archive members.
Traced Bash redirections, Python AST, vLLM object serialization and receiver deserialization.
Serialized only the reviewed reducer class, then used pickletools disassembly. Did not unpickle, run a shell payload, or execute module-level network code.

upstream_mechanism.facts: create constructs TCPStore with is_master=(rank == 0); send_obj writes pickle.dumps(obj) under a destination key; recv_obj applies pickle.loads to bytes from that store.
upstream_mechanism.scope: Representative version used to verify library semantics; the target deployment and its installed version were not supplied.

samples.identification: Mixed advisory and shell payload TAR
samples.behavior_and_reason: The separately runnable run.sh is byte-identical to live.sh. It opens a TCP socket through Bash /dev/tcp, redirects shell output/error to it, duplicates that descriptor onto stdin, then invokes interactive Bash. notice.json is an inert OSV-style advisory quoting Python exploit examples; it does not launch run.sh. No autostart or install trigger is present. The executable shell payload, independent of advisory text, tips the judgment.
samples.context_limits: Mode 0600 and no shebang mean explicit interpreter invocation is needed. The callback address 198.51.100.10 is TEST-NET-2, so successful contact or an operational C2 cannot be inferred. Authorized test context and deployment history are absent.
samples.hostile_coverage_goal: Two existing hostile findings cover the sole supported hostile action: the Bash TCP reverse shell. Full source/member inspection, parser facts, and redirection tracing exposed no persistence, staging, evasion, exfiltration or cleanup behavior. No third distinct hostile behavior is supported, rather than a matcher limitation preventing detection. Do not add redundant traits to reach three.
samples.classifier_disagreement: None; all original classifiers remain HOSTILE. The advisory member remains free of hostile and suspicious findings.
samples.marker_line: Mixed archive: runnable reverse shell beside an inert advisory

samples.behavior_and_reason: At module load, rank 1 joins the group at 172.17.0.1:18888 and sends an Evil instance to rank 0. __reduce__ returns os.system with an explicit Bash reverse shell to 172.28.176.1:8888. The producer serializes the recipe; the receiver invokes the command during unpickling. The deliberate remote command-execution recipe and callback shell tip the judgment over ordinary distributed metadata exchange.
samples.context_limits: A standalone exploitation PoC can be used for authorized research. No authorization, target version, listener, reachable server, or actual compromise is established. The filename and advisory identity are not the basis for conviction.
samples.hostile_coverage_goal: Four hostile findings: three preserved reverse-shell observations plus the newly covered pickle exploit delivery. No supported hostile behavior remains uncovered in this small source.
samples.classifier_disagreement: None; all original classifiers remain HOSTILE. The advisory member remains free of hostile and suspicious findings.
samples.marker_line: vLLM PoC: sends a reverse-shell pickle; detect bound delivery

description_corrections.micro-behaviors/process/create/shell/spa: The matcher requires a Bash command word and launch arguments, rather than merely mentioning Bash or finding a shell keyword. Matcher, location, consumers and severity are unchanged.
description_corrections.micro-behaviors/data/control-flow/module: The parsed top-level call establishes execution at module load; the description now states the observed behavior. Matcher, location, consumers and severity are unchanged.

changes.placement: Network socket creation and object send are neutral capabilities. A command-bearing reducer bound to a transmitted instance is exploit evidence. The hostile composite additionally requires receiver value-flow provenance and same-call evidence proximity.
changes.scope: The advisory exclusion is file-local; a sibling advisory must not suppress a live archive member.
changes.known_matcher_limits: The new exploit rule covers direct unaliased StatelessProcessGroup imports, an assigned literal Bash -c command immediately returned through os.system in __reduce__ or __reduce_ex__, and a direct class constructor in the obj keyword. It does not claim complete alias, control-flow, mutation or interprocedural analysis.

controls.result: All explicit delivery assertions passed, including mixed TAR member scope. Ordinary vLLM sends retain notable capabilities. Object, command, sender and overwritten-command mismatches reject the delivery claim. An overwritten receiver plus a separate ordinary send also rejects it.
controls.existing_positive: The existing testdata/pickle-reducer/variant.py, copied outside the intentional test-directory exclusion, retained both executable-reducer and executable-pickle-multipart-send (suspicious). Existing benign and unrelated controls retained neither.
